name: rivalghost
description: A deterministic arcade rivalry game built for NEAR.

scripts.check: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @rivalghost/verifier... build && pnpm --filter @rivalghost/relayer... build && vitest run --passWithNoTests
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --recursive run build && pnpm --recursive run typecheck
scripts.contract:check: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo test --locked --workspace && pnpm contract:size && node tools/contract-wasm-smoke.mjs
